description: Least-privilege capability for the camera bubble's own controls mid-recording (label capture-bubble-controls), a small window over the bubble that the recording leaves out. It listens for capture_state_changed and capture_camera_state, and calls the app-defined capture_state, capture_camera_context, capture_pause, capture_resume and capture_camera_set_size commands (not capability-gated). It is never dragged: the bubble under it is. core permissions only: it floats over every app.
